claim_boundary: A passing receipt proves only that a bounded set of decoded samples - the first, midpoint, and last frame of every episode - carry finite 16-dimensional observation.state and action vectors and finite channel-first (CHW) images of the declared shapes (env_cam 3x240x320; both wrist cameras 3x240x424) with pixel values in [0,1]. It does not prove learned-policy success, task generalization, training convergence, model inference quality, AMD/ROCm execution, GPU utilization, hardware gripper behavior, closed-loop control, or the integrity of every frame in the full dataset.
